preconditions.description: The first line of input is the length of the string s.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only '(', ')', and '?' characters.
The length of s is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ':(' or (all(c in '()' for c in stdout) and len(stdout) == len(s) and is_valid_replacement(s, stdout))
postconditions.description: The output is either ':(' if no valid replacement exists, or a string of the same length as s with only '(' and ')' characters, where all strict prefixes of the output are not correct parenthesis sequences, and the entire output is a correct parenthesis sequence.
